Strong understanding of microphone acoustics, including frequency response, tonal consistency, self-noise, dynamic range, SPL handling, and low-latency audio performance. Knowledge of audio signal processing, including companding, A/D and D/A conversion, gain structure, DSP features, encryption impacts, and maintaining audio integrity. Experience with networked audio and device management, including Dante™, AES67, QoS, device synchronization, remote configuration, firmware updates, and troubleshooting Ethernet/TCP/IP-based audio networks. Testing & Quality: Proficient in functional, regression, exploratory, stress, reliability, and environmental testing. Skilled at designing real-world test scenarios and evaluating complex interactions across RF, audio, and networking domains. Experienced with professional test equipment such as spectrum analyzers, audio analyzers, oscilloscopes, and network analysis tools. Proficient with defect tracking and test management tools (e.g., JIRA), with strong documentation and defect-reporting skills.
